StorageBench.percentile (BenchStorage.swift:590-598) is nearest rank: index = ceil(fraction*n) - 1, clamped to [0, n-1], taken over values.sorted(), which is a copy (the parameter is an immutable value). For n = 509/519/520/525/528 the index is 503/513/514/519/522, i.e. n-6, the sixth-longest unit. Tolerance: 5 units over 5 ms for 500 <= n <= 599, 4 for 400-499, 6 at n = 600. 0.99*n was checked in IEEE double; there is no rounding hazard for n in 400-699.

Empty input returns 0, which would be a vacuous pass. But reclaim() also asserts units.count >= 10000/64 = 156 (:254; StoreTypes.swift:46 deletionBatchSize 64) and reapedKeys == count (:251), so an empty or partial population fails the test.

Population: TimingExecutor (BenchStorage.swift:604-637) records the ContinuousClock wall time and thread CPU of each work() on the wrapped serial queue, which runs at utility QoS (Sources/ZTronAssetModel/Environment/BlockingExecutor.swift:41). The P-13 store's metadata executor is that timer (:226-232). It is reset at :235 after apply(empty) and read at :239 before close(). Every deletion unit runs through runUnit(on: metadataExecutor) (Sources/ZTronAssetStorage/Store/AssetStore+Reaper.swift:183-185); runUnit only adds a drain counter (AssetStore+Lifecycle.swift:57-63). BlobDeletionUnit.run (BlobUnits.swift:162-182) is exactly the unit: at most 64 keys and a 1 ms predicted budget.

Nothing else is mixed into the population. runDueWork's only other metadata-executor call is the coalesced commit (AssetStore+Reaper.swift:118-131 calling AssetStore+Commit.swift:125), and it runs only when a soon commit is pending. apply commits its own writes, startGrace marks nothing dirty (AssetStore+Snapshot.swift:85-94), and the reaper marks changes .lazy (AssetStore+Reaper.swift:216). The snapshot install goes to the sink, not the executor (AssetStore+Lifecycle.swift:66-73). unlinkProfile runs after :239, on its own LiveFileSystem in another directory (:482-497). Every over-budget unit in the four e840b0e runs has 0.22-1.02 ms on CPU, i.e. a stalled deletion unit, not a commit.
Nothing is excluded: work.reapedKeys == 10,000 (:251) puts every deletion inside the timed window, and the timed interval wraps exactly work(); the lock append happens after elapsed is computed.
